name: Tilly
character: Tilly checks every bank line against the books before anyone is awake. Tilly likes things to add up.
function: Matches bank lines and records between systems. Does not post a journal or approve a payment.

name: Ivy
role: Turns forms into jobs and invoices
character: Ivy takes each form your team submits and writes the job, the invoice draft or the work order from it.
function: Turns submitted forms into jobs, invoice drafts and work orders. Does not contact a customer.

name: Paige
character: Paige puts the reporting pack together overnight, so it is waiting when you sit down.
function: Builds the reporting packs from source. Does not change a figure.

name: Drew
character: Drew drafts every quote and document from one record. You read it and press send.
function: Drafts quotes and documents from one record. Does not send anything.

name: Link
character: Link keeps your systems matching each other and lists anything that does not.
function: Keeps records in step between systems and lists the exceptions. Does not resolve an exception.
